items.text: The desktop distribution and app-directory packaging evidence identifies the expected DMG and app bundle, verifies arm64 architecture, minimum macOS 15.0.0, unsigned or adhoc posture, required instruction-root assets and passing integrity summary, an executable SDK subprocess in package layout, and preserved current shipped Anthropic network guardrails; missing assets, failed integrity, failed subprocess execution, or unresolved required evidence remain explicit blockers.

verification.text: Run or review the accepted pre-packaging checks, desktop:dist and desktop:pack evidence; inspect DMG and app-bundle identities, architecture, minimum OS, signing posture, packaged resources, integrity summary, SDK subprocess probe, network guardrails, and residual blocker records.
